theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (V B : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V (m + 1)) (G : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), B ⊆ V → (∀ β : TestFormOn V m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m) ⊆ B → X.boundary β = 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V (m + 1), X ω = ∫ y, G y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)) → ∀ a : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ B → ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), ∫ v in B, G v * fderiv ℝ a v (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = 0
